**The design is fixed and all visible tests pass.**

The bug was in the handshake logic at rtl/mult_seq.v:38. The code was accepting a new `start` signal unconditionally with `if (start)`, but according to rule 2 of the spec, "If `start = 1` while `busy = 1`, it has no effect at all."

The fix adds a check `!busy` so that a new multiplication is only accepted when the multiplier is idle: `if (start && !busy)`. This ensures that if a start pulse arrives while an operation is in progress, the current operation continues undisturbed without being restarted.
